title: @arraypress/covers recipe
description: A cover style as data: params, vars and a stack of layers. See the README, "JSON recipes".

params.description: Options this recipe reads, with defaults. Cover options of the same name override them; use them as "{name}".

vars.description: Named values, resolved in order (draws use the recipe stream); use them as "$name".

token.description: @bg @text @accent @onAccent @muted @surface @mode @colors @colors.N @width @height @u · $var · {param} {title} {label} {icon} {image} {opt.x} · a length ("12vmin", "4vw") · a colour · any text

anyOf.description: Mix two colours: [a, b, t] in OKLab, or [a, b, t, "oklch"] (hue the short way, stays vivid).
White, or near-black on a light colour: c, [c, light, dark], or [backgrounds, ratio, prefer] (prefer "white" | "black" | a colour when it clears ratio on every background).
[color, { l: [min, max], c: [min, max] }]: the colour pulled into an OKLCH band, hue kept.
[colors, angle, size]: the colours a centred square of that size covers in a linear gradient.
[from, to, steps, amount?]: steps colours from one toward the other.

if.description: A choice: only the chosen side is evaluated.

condition.description: "title" (the option is set), { "background": "gradient" } (equals; "mode" is the palette's), { "not": … }, { "all": [...] }, { "any": [...] }.

id.description: Names the layer for overrides (cover({ <id>: {...} | false })).

when.description: Include the layer only when this holds.

size.description: [min, max] radius, fractions of the longer side.

base.description: Fill under the fields: "auto" (a gradient across the sweep between the first two colours; default), "bg", a colour, or null.

arrangement.description: sweep (default: long fields along one direction) | ring

angle.description: Sweep direction in degrees. Default seeded.

streak.description: How much more the sweep blurs along than across. Default 1.5.

tone.description: { l: [min, max], c: [min, max] }: pull colours into an OKLCH band.

fold.description: true or { color, to, position, bend, softness, sheen }: a second field meeting the first along a soft curve.

streaks.description: Thin light motion streaks along the sweep. Default 0.

from.description: A photo (path or bytes) to take the colours from (needs sharp).

blobs.description: Explicit [{ x, y, r, squash, rotate, color, opacity }].

src.description: A local path, data: URI or bytes ("{image}").

tint.description: A colour or { color, amount, blend }.

fade.description: none | radial | edges | top | bottom | left | right

divisions.description: Grid/lines: N equal cells (inner lines only) instead of size.

gaps.description: [{ x, y, width, height }] fractions the lines break around.

items.description: [{ kind, x, y, size, color, rotate, opacity }]

color.description: Default the accent on a tile, else @text.

tile.description: true or { size, radius, color, shadow, border }.

label.description: A string or { content, size, weight, color, letterSpacing, transform, gap }.

background.description: A colour or { color, radius, padding, opacity }.

icon.description: One icon (Iconify name or raw SVG), drawn as white line-art.

nodes.description: [{ icon, shape: square | circle | none, size, brackets }]

layout.description: single | row | triangle | square | stack | hub

shape.description: For a single icon: none (default) | square | circle.

iconScale.description: Icon size inside a tile, 0–1. Default 0.44.

grid.description: true or { divisions, opacity, stroke, color, pad }: a dotted grid that breaks around the drawing.

kind.description: mixed | rect | square | circle | blob | arch | pill

items.description: [{ kind, x, y, width, height, size, rotate, color }] placed in the region.

wobble.description: How rough the cut edges are, 0–1. Default 0.5.

icon.description: An icon to re-draw by hand (Iconify name or raw SVG).

graph.description: true or { nodes, dot }: a hand-drawn node graph instead.

color.description: The ink: a colour or riso:pink | blue | yellow | teal | red | green | orange | purple | navy | black.

shapes.description: [{ kind: circle | ring | half | arch | band | rect | text, x, y, r, size, width, height, thickness, rotate, content, … }]

offset.description: { x, y }: misregistration. Default seeded, 0.3–1% of the short side.

speckle.description: Grain: share of paper showing through. Default 0.09.

dot.description: Halftone dot radius, fraction of the cell.

density.description: [min, max]: uneven ink across the sheet. Default [0.78, 1].

colors.description: [ground, ink] or [c0, c1, c2] (two dithered bands).

highlight.description: Level to draw in the accent (default seeded), or false.

index.description: Every Nth line thicker. Default 5 (0: none).

resolution.description: Grid cells across the short side.

audio.description: An audio file to decode at build (needs @arraypress/waveform-gen).

caption.description: true (the duration) or text under the wave.

rows.description: Rows. Default to keep cells near square.

series.description: Seeds the grid rhythm shared by a series.

kinds.description: Subset of quarter, half, circle, square, triangle.
